details.further_information: The transfer fee could rise from €30 million to €35 million with bonuses. Fenerbahçe will receive 10% of the next sale. Transfer from NEC Nijmegen to Fenerbahçe for €1.4 million. Nijmegen received a 10% (€3 million) share of the player's next sale from Fenerbahçe and a €500,000 solidarity contribution from Brighton. Ferdi Kadıoğlu became the youngest player to play for NEC Nijmengen in the Eredivisie (16 years 326 days / 28.08.2016)
